kreesthe maargam sathyam jeevam kreesthe manakaadhaaram

credits.Music: J K Christopher & M Param Jyothi

intro: Prema Kaligi is the Christian Telugu song from the album, Asha Theera written by Pastor N J Simon and tuned by Philip Gariki, sung by Sharon Sisters, music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher & M Param Jyothi. This song video was released on March 27, 2021 through JK Christopher YouTube Channel.
